tests.description: Creates a user on a MacOS system with dscl

tests.name: Create a new user in a command prompt
tests.description:
Creates a new user in a command prompt. Upon execution, "The command completed successfully." will be displayed. To verify the
new account, run "net user" in powershell or CMD and observe that there is a new user named "T1136.001_CMD"

tests.name: Create a new user in PowerShell
tests.description:
Creates a new user in PowerShell. Upon execution, details about the new account will be displayed in the powershell session. To verify the
new account, run "net user" in powershell or CMD and observe that there is a new user named "T1136.001_PowerShell"

tests.name: Create a new user in Linux with `root` UID and GID.
tests.description: Creates a new user in Linux and adds the user to the `root` group. This technique was used by adversaries during the Butter attack campaign.

tests.name: Create a new user in FreeBSD with `root` GID.
tests.description: Creates a new user in FreeBSD and adds the user to the `root` group. This technique was used by adversaries during the Butter attack campaign.

tests.name: Create a new Windows admin user
tests.description: Creates a new admin user in a command prompt.

tests.name: Create a new Windows admin user via .NET
tests.description: Creates a new admin user in a powershell session without using net.exe

tests.name: Create a Linux user via kubectl in a Pod
tests.description:
Launches a short-lived Alpine pod and creates a Linux user inside the pod.
The pod is automatically deleted after execution.
